name: The Device
source:
An unusual kobold, an unexpected goblin attack, and an unstable artifact lead to a steamy encounter in the woods!

[From [url=https://koboldkinks.itch.io/the-device]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一個不同尋常的狗頭人，一場意料之外的哥布林襲擊，再加上一件不穩定的魔法器物，促成了林間的一場火熱邂逅！

[摘自[url=https://koboldkinks.itch.io/the-device]itch.io[/url]]
